model: finite-volume massive vector modes + two-active-flavor massless nu/antinu thermal FD(T,mu) constrained closure, only Zprime↔ννbar on-shell quantum Pauli/Bose
method: exact vector exponential 1<->2 microphysical mode updates at momentarily frozen Tnu,mu, re-solve FD T,mu from Nnu+2NV and total energy each step; assumed fast ν number/energy-conserving redistribution

negative.time_splitting_tau100: 20,40,80 substeps T=1.24573957,1.24469364,1.24416424, approximately first order ~1.98; conservation/entropy alone do not prove convergence

negative.cutoff: cut p/T0=25 vs35 shifts T by 4.32e-7 at tau3000; smooth benchmark not full nonthermal uncertainty

limitation: Fast ν thermal redistribution assumed not derived; no actual e/γ weak chemistry, H, χ1/χ2/φ dynamics, Γel or 86eV ΩDM/BEC/CLASS
